delegated_field: `Fato de violação de direito autoral`'s `violação de direito de autor ou de direito conexo, segundo a lei de direitos autorais` and `exceção ou limitação ao direito de autor ou conexo, prevista na Lei nº 9.610, de 1998`

site.anchor: violação de direitos de autor e dos que lhe são conexos (art. 184, caput)

source.quote: Violar direitos de autor e os que lhe são conexos:

citations.cite: CP art. 184, caput (redação da Lei nº 10.695/2003)
CP art. 184, § 4º — "em conformidade com o previsto na Lei nº 9.610, de 19 de fevereiro de 1998"
Vide Lei nº 5.988, de 1973 (V3, SOURCE/vide-index.tsv)

readings.description: Art. 184 is a norma penal em branco. Whether a direito de autor or a connected right exists, whether it was violated, and whether a use is an exception or limitation, are answered by the copyright law in force, Lei nº 9.610/1998 (and, for computer programs, Lei nº 9.609/1998). The encoding takes those answers as findings the fact supplier makes under that law, and encodes none of it.

citations.cite: Lei nº 9.610/1998, art. 1º: "Esta Lei regula os direitos autorais, entendendo-se sob esta denominação os direitos de autor e os que lhes são conexos" — the caput's own words
CP art. 184, § 4º names Lei nº 9.610/1998 as the source of the exceptions and limitations

readings.description: The rights are those of Lei nº 5.988/1973, the law the Code's own "Vide" marker V3 points to.
readings.rejection_rationale: Lei nº 9.610/1998, art. 115, revoked Lei nº 5.988/1973 except its art. 17 and §§ 1º–2º (on registration). The Vide marker survives in the compiled Code as a historical pointer; the 2003 wording of art. 184 uses Lei nº 9.610's vocabulary, and § 4º cites Lei nº 9.610 by name.

citations.cite: Lei nº 9.610/1998, art. 115: "Ficam revogados ... as Leis nºs ... 5.988, de 14 de dezembro de 1973, excetuando-se o art. 17 e seus §§ 1º e 2º"

readings.description: Encode the relevant parts of Lei nº 9.610/1998 (what is protected, who holds the right, the exceptions of arts. 46–48) so that the violation is computed rather than supplied.
readings.rejection_rationale: Lei nº 9.610 is outside the source bundle and the brief ("read these and nothing else"); the brief for g3b asks for it as a fact supplier, not an encoding.

taken.rationale: The Code does not define the rights; the copyright law does, in the caput's own words. Two booleans on the case record carry its answers: that there is a violation, and that the use is an exception or limitation. By Lei nº 9.610/1998, art. 46 ("Não constitui ofensa aos direitos autorais"), a use within an exception is no violation, so a consistent supplier who reports an exception reports no violation; the encoding does not repair an inconsistent pair, and a test shows the consistent one.

notes: V3 (Lei nº 5.988/1973) was not examined by any sweep (sweep-b's S-sweep-b-01 lists it among 'Dispositivo Correlato' rows not individually swept). g3b read Lei nº 9.610/1998 arts. 1º, 46 and 115 on Planalto on 2026-09-29 to answer it; nothing there changes the Code's text.
The phrase in art. 184 reads "os que lhe são conexos" (singular "lhe"); Lei nº 9.610, art. 1º, has "lhes". The difference is grammatical, not legal.

site.anchor: a violação de direitos de autor de programa de computador é crime da Lei nº 9.609, de 1998, que não está codificada

source.quote: Violar direitos de autor e os que lhe são conexos:

citations.cite: CP art. 184, caput
Lei nº 9.609/1998, art. 12: "Violar direitos de autor de programa de computador: Pena - Detenção de seis meses a dois anos ou multa."

readings.description: A computer program's author's rights are protected by their own crime, Lei nº 9.609/1998, art. 12, which displaces art. 184 by speciality (art. 12 of the Code). Art. 184 does not answer for a program, and the encoding, which does not contain Lei nº 9.609, refuses by name.

citations.cite: Lei nº 9.609/1998, art. 12 (read on Planalto, 2026-09-29)
CP art. 12 (the Code's general rules apply to special laws "se esta não dispuser de modo diverso")

readings.description: Art. 184 applies to programs as to any work, Lei nº 9.609 notwithstanding.
readings.foreclosure: The special law describes the same conduct for the same object with its own penalty; the general law yields. Not refuted by any authority g3b read; no court decision was searched.

citations.cite: CP art. 184, caput — "Violar direitos de autor" names no class of work, so read alone it reaches a program

taken.rationale: Where the answer lies in a law the encoding does not contain, the honest shape is a named refusal (phrasebook entries 1.6 and 11.5), not FALSE: a program's violation is a crime, just not this article's. The gate is asserted directly in the tests.

witnesses: `a pirataria de programa de computador` — refuses under the taken reading; would be art. 184, § 1º under the other
notes: Not examined by sweep-b. For the conductor: Lei nº 9.609/1998 is outside the source bundle; its art. 12 was read only to name it.

site.anchor: o disposto nos §§ 1º, 2º e 3º não se aplica (art. 184, § 4º)

source.quote: O disposto nos §§ 1o, 2o e 3o não se aplica quando se tratar de exceção ou limitação ao direito de autor ou os que lhe são conexos, em conformidade com o previsto na Lei nº 9.610, de 19 de fevereiro de 1998, nem a cópia de obra intelectual ou fonograma, em um só exemplar, para uso privado do copista, sem intuito de lucro direto ou indireto.

citations.cite: CP art. 184, § 4º

readings.description: § 4º takes its two cases out of §§ 1º to 3º only, as it says. A single private copy of a whole work, without profit, is not § 1º; it remains the caput's violation wherever the copyright law finds it one (Lei nº 9.610/1998, art. 46, II, excepts only "a reprodução, em um só exemplar de pequenos trechos, para uso privado do copista").

citations.cite: CP art. 184, § 4º — "O disposto nos §§ 1o, 2o e 3o"
Lei nº 9.610/1998, art. 46, II

readings.description: § 4º declares the single private copy without profit lawful altogether, so it is not the caput's crime either.
readings.foreclosure: The paragraph names §§ 1º, 2º and 3º and not the caput; and whether the copy is lawful is the copyright law's question, which answers it through the delegated finding (F-g3b-01). A court reading the paragraph as a policy of decriminalising private copying could adopt this reading.

citations.cite: CP art. 184, § 4º — "nem a cópia de obra intelectual ou fonograma, em um só exemplar, para uso privado do copista, sem intuito de lucro direto ou indireto", read as a statement of what is lawful

taken.rationale: The text's own scope. The second limb is then declaratory for §§ 1º to 3º, which all require profit; the tests assert it both ways (private copy with and without profit).

witnesses: `a cópia privada única de obra inteira` — caput (queixa) under the taken reading, no crime under the other

site.anchor: violação de direito autoral qualificada do art. 184, § 2º

source.quote: original ou cópia de obra intelectual ou fonograma reproduzido com violação do direito de autor, do direito de artista intérprete ou executante ou do direito do produtor de fonograma, ou, ainda, aluga original ou cópia de obra intelectual ou fonograma, sem a expressa autorização dos titulares dos direitos ou de quem os represente.

citations.cite: CP art. 184, § 2º

readings.description: "sem a expressa autorização" closes the rental limb ("ou, ainda, aluga ..."). The first limb is already qualified by "reproduzido com violação"; dealing in such a copy is § 2º whether or not the holder consents to the dealing.

citations.cite: CP art. 184, § 2º — the clause follows the second limb, after "ou, ainda,"

readings.description: "sem a expressa autorização" qualifies both limbs, so dealing with the holder's authorisation is never § 2º.

citations.cite: CP art. 184, § 2º, read as one period

taken.rationale: Placement: the clause sits after "ou, ainda,", which opens the second limb, and only that limb's object may be a lawful copy, for which authorisation is what separates a lawful rental from a crime. The first limb's object is unlawful by description. "com o intuito de lucro" governs both limbs, since both verbs hang on the one "quem".

witnesses: `a venda de cópia pirata autorizada pelo titular` — § 2º under the taken reading, not under the other
notes: The witness is a corner case: a holder who authorises the sale of copies reproduced in violation of their own right. It is recorded because the two readings do answer it differently.

site.anchor: a ação penal do art. 186

source.quote: III – ação penal pública incondicionada, nos crimes cometidos em desfavor de entidades de direito público, autarquia, empresa pública, sociedade de economia mista ou fundação instituída pelo Poder Público;

citations.cite: CP art. 186, I a IV

readings.description: Where the offended party is one of the public entities of inciso III, the action is public and unconditional whatever the form: III overrides I (queixa for the caput) and IV (representação for § 3º).

citations.cite: CP art. 186, III — for §§ 1º and 2º it repeats II, so it changes an answer only by overriding I and IV

readings.description: The form decides (I, II, IV), and III covers only the crimes against public entities that no other inciso reaches.
readings.rejection_rationale: Every crime of art. 184 is reached by one of I, II or IV, so on this reading III would have no case of its own. A provision is not read as surplusage when a reading gives it work.

taken.rationale: Arm order in `a ação penal do art. 186`: III is asked before the form. The comment at the site says the order is the encoding's, and why.

witnesses: `a violação simples contra autarquia` — incondicionada, not queixa
`o streaming contra empresa pública` — incondicionada, not condicionada à representação

site.anchor: mediante violência ou grave ameaça (arts. 197 a 199)

source.quote: Constranger alguém, mediante violência ou grave ameaça:

citations.cite: CP art. 197, caput
CP art. 203 — "Frustrar, mediante fraude ou violência"
CP art. 208, parágrafo único — "Se há emprego de violência"
CP art. 200 — "praticando violência contra pessoa ou contra coisa"

readings.description: "violência" alone is violence against a person. Violence against a thing is reached only where the text says so, as art. 200 does ("contra pessoa ou contra coisa").

citations.cite: CP art. 200 — the Code names "contra coisa" where it means it
CP arts. 197–199 — violence as a means of constraining a person

readings.description: "violência" includes violence against things, so breaking the furnishings of a church during a service, or a coffin during a burial, brings in the increase of arts. 208 and 209, parágrafo único.

citations.cite: CP arts. 208 and 209, parágrafo único — "Se há emprego de violência", unqualified; "sem prejuízo da correspondente à violência" fits damage to a thing, which has its own offence (art. 163), as well as injury to a person

taken.rationale: One reading across the Títulos: art. 200, in the same Título, adds "contra coisa" when it means both, which argues that the bare word means the person; and in arts. 197–199 the violence is the means of constraining someone. For arts. 208 and 209 the other reading is not refuted — the penalty "correspondente à violência" fits damage as well as injury — and is flagged for a lawyer.

witnesses: `o culto perturbado com violência contra coisa` (art. 208) — no increase under the taken reading, one third under the other
`o enterro perturbado com violência contra coisa` (art. 209)

site.anchor: abandono coletivo (art. 200, parágrafo único)
provisions: CP art. 200, caput e parágrafo único

source.quote: Participar de suspensão ou abandono coletivo de trabalho

citations.cite: CP art. 200, caput
CP art. 200, parágrafo único — "Para que se considere coletivo o abandono de trabalho é indispensável o concurso de, pelo menos, três empregados."

readings.description: "coletivo" (masculine) agrees with "abandono" and not with "suspensão" (feminine): it is the abandonment, the employees' stoppage, that must be collective, and the parágrafo único defines only "coletivo o abandono". A suspension (the employer's stoppage) needs no count. The three employees include the agent where the agent is one of them.

citations.cite: CP art. 200, caput — gender agreement
CP art. 200, parágrafo único — speaks only of "o abandono de trabalho"

readings.description: "coletivo" qualifies both nouns, so a suspension too must involve at least three employees.
readings.rejection_rationale: It would need "coletiva" for "suspensão", and the parágrafo único counts employees, who do not make a suspension.

taken.rationale: The grammar and the parágrafo único's own words. The count is `número de empregados que concorreram para o abandono`, whose herald says the agent is included if an employee.

witnesses: `o locaute, com violência contra coisa` — art. 200 with no count under the taken reading, not art. 200 under the other

site.anchor: participar de suspensão ou abandono coletivo de trabalho (arts. 200 e 201)

source.quote: Para que se considere coletivo o abandono de trabalho é indispensável o concurso de, pelo menos, três empregados.

citations.cite: CP art. 200, parágrafo único
CP art. 201 — "Participar de suspensão ou abandono coletivo de trabalho"

readings.description: The parágrafo único defines the phrase that arts. 200 and 201 share word for word, in adjacent articles of one Título; art. 201's "abandono coletivo" needs three employees too.

citations.cite: CP arts. 200 and 201 — the same words

readings.description: A parágrafo único belongs to its article; in art. 201 "coletivo" is an open standard for the judge.
readings.foreclosure: Reading the definition into art. 201 narrows the offence, so it is not an analogy against the accused; and the alternative leaves the same word of the same Título with two meanings. A court following topography strictly could adopt it.

citations.cite: CP art. 200, parágrafo único — placed in art. 200

taken.rationale: Same words, same Título, and the reading favours the accused.

witnesses: `a greve de dois no transporte` — not art. 201 under the taken reading; a question for the judge under the other

site.anchor: paralisação de trabalho seguida de violência do art. 200

source.quote: Participar de suspensão ou abandono coletivo de trabalho, praticando violência contra pessoa ou contra coisa:

citations.cite: CP art. 200

readings.description: "praticando" has the participant as its subject: the one who practises the violence while taking part commits art. 200. Another participant is reached, if at all, as a co-author (art. 29).

citations.cite: CP art. 200 — the gerund's subject
CP art. 29

readings.description: Everyone who takes part in a stoppage during which violence occurs commits art. 200.
readings.rejection_rationale: The gerund attaches the violence to the one who participates; and criminal liability is personal.

taken.rationale: The means on `Fato` are the agent's own; a stoppage where only others were violent has no violence among the agent's means.

notes: The case record records only the agent's means, so the encoding cannot exhibit the other reading: the taken reading is carried by what the field records.

site.anchor: paralisação de trabalho de interesse coletivo do art. 201

source.quote: Participar de suspensão ou abandono coletivo de trabalho, provocando a interrupção de obra pública ou serviço de interesse coletivo:

citations.cite: CP art. 201

CF art. 9º: "É assegurado o direito de greve, competindo aos trabalhadores decidir sobre a oportunidade de exercê-lo e sobre os interesses que devam por meio dele defender." (read on Planalto, 2026-09-29)

readings.description: Art. 201 applies as written: taking part in a collective stoppage that interrupts a public work or a service of collective interest is the crime, whether or not the strike is lawful under the strike law.

citations.cite: CP art. 201

readings.description: A strike exercised under the right to strike and within Lei nº 7.783/1989 (which, for essential services, requires the indispensable services to be kept up, art. 11) is lawful and outside art. 201; only abuse of the right (art. 14) and crimes committed in its course (art. 15) are punished.

citations.cite: Lei nº 7.783/1989, art. 14: "Constitui abuso do direito de greve a inobservância das normas contidas na presente Lei ..."; art. 15: "A responsabilidade pelos atos praticados, ilícitos ou crimes cometidos, no curso da greve, será apurada, conforme o caso, segundo a legislação trabalhista, civil ou penal." (read on Planalto, 2026-09-29)
CF art. 9º

readings.description: Art. 201 was not received by the 1988 Constitution, which guarantees the right to strike without the Code's limit.

citations.cite: CF art. 9º

taken.rationale: Encoded as the text stands so that the article is not silently dropped, and flagged OPEN: no binding authority was read either way, and the P2 sweep did not examine the question. The other two readings are the ones a court is likely to weigh.

witnesses: `a greve de três no transporte` — a peaceful strike interrupting a service of collective interest: art. 201 under the taken reading; lawful under the other two, if within Lei nº 7.783/1989
notes: For the conductor and sweep-b: whether an STF or STJ decision settles the reception of art. 201 (and of art. 200, whose violence keeps it outside the right to strike on any reading) was not searched. Lei nº 7.783/1989 and CF art. 9º were read only to cite them.

delegated_field: `Fato de frustração de direito trabalhista`'s `frustração de direito assegurado pela legislação do trabalho`

site.anchor: frustração de direito trabalhista do art. 203, caput

source.quote: Frustrar, mediante fraude ou violência, direito assegurado pela legislação do trabalho:

citations.cite: CP art. 203, caput

readings.description: Art. 203 is a norma penal em branco: which rights the labour legislation assures is for that legislation (the CLT and the rest) to say. The encoding takes the finding that the conduct frustrated such a right.

citations.cite: CP art. 203 — "direito assegurado pela legislação do trabalho"

readings.description: Encode the rights of the labour legislation so that the finding is computed.
readings.rejection_rationale: Outside the source bundle and the brief.

taken.rationale: The Code points to another body of law for the right; the fact supplier applies it.

site.anchor: frustração de direito trabalhista do art. 203, § 1º, II

source.quote: II - impede alguém de se desligar de serviços de qualquer natureza, mediante coação ou por meio da retenção de seus documentos pessoais ou contratuais.

citations.cite: CP art. 203, § 1º, II

readings.description: "coação" is constraint by violence against the person or by a serious threat, the means the Code names for constraining someone elsewhere ("Constranger alguém, mediante violência ou grave ameaça", arts. 146 and 197–199).

citations.cite: CP arts. 197–199 — "mediante violência ou grave ameaça"

readings.description: "coação" covers any threat or pressure that keeps the worker from leaving, a plain threat included.

citations.cite: CP art. 203, § 1º, II — "coação", unqualified

taken.rationale: The Code's own words for constraining a person; and the second means of the same inciso, the retention of documents, shows that the drafter listed a lesser means separately where it wanted one.

witnesses: `o desligamento impedido com ameaça simples` — not § 1º, II under the taken reading, § 1º, II under the other

site.anchor: vítima menor de dezoito anos, idosa, gestante, indígena ou portadora de deficiência física ou mental

source.quote: se a vítima é menor de dezoito anos, idosa, gestante, indígena ou portadora de deficiência física ou mental.

citations.cite: CP art. 203, § 2º
CP art. 207, § 2º

readings.description: "física ou mental" names two natures of disability and not a third: a sensory (visual or hearing) disability is not within them. "mental" includes what is now called intellectual disability, which was its name in 1998.

citations.cite: CF art. 227, § 1º, II, in its 1988 wording in force when Lei nº 9.777/1998 was enacted: "para os portadores de deficiência física, sensorial ou mental" — the constitutional vocabulary of the time counted three natures (read on Planalto, 2026-09-29)
A cause of increase is read strictly

readings.description: "deficiência física ou mental" means any disability; the purpose is to protect the vulnerable worker, and a blind or deaf worker is as vulnerable.

citations.cite: CP arts. 203 and 207, § 2º — the class the paragraph protects

taken.rationale: The words, read in the vocabulary of their time, in which the Constitution itself listed sensory disability separately; and a cause of increase is not extended by purpose. The shared noun `pessoa com deficiência` does not say which nature, so the case record for arts. 203 and 207 carries the nature (`Condição do trabalhador (arts. 203 e 207)`).

witnesses: `contra a trabalhadora cega` — no increase under the taken reading, one sixth to one third under the other

site.anchor: incide o aumento do art. 203, § 2º

source.quote: A pena é aumentada de um sexto a um terço se a vítima é menor de dezoito anos

citations.cite: CP art. 203, § 2º
CP art. 207, § 2º

readings.description: Where the crime has several victims, the increase applies if any of them is in the class.

citations.cite: CP arts. 203 and 207, § 2º — "a vítima"

readings.description: The increase applies only if every victim is in the class.
readings.rejection_rationale: An adult co-victim would then remove the protection the paragraph gives the minor beside them.

taken.rationale: The paragraph protects each victim in the class; the encoding counts one crime per case, and how several crimes against several victims combine (arts. 69–71) is the judge's.

witnesses: `contra Ana e Bruno, antes dos dezoito dele` — increase under the taken reading, none under the other

site.anchor: trabalhadores, no plural (arts. 206 e 207)

source.quote: Recrutar trabalhadores, mediante fraude, com o fim de levá-los para território estrangeiro.

citations.cite: CP art. 206
CP art. 207 — "Aliciar trabalhadores"; § 1º — "recrutar trabalhadores"

readings.description: The plural asks for two or more workers.

citations.cite: CP arts. 206 and 207 — "trabalhadores"

readings.description: At least three, borrowing art. 200's number for a collective act of labour.
readings.foreclosure: Art. 200's number is for the collective abandonment of work, a different thing from recruiting; the plural itself says only "more than one".

citations.cite: CP art. 200, parágrafo único — "pelo menos, três empregados"

readings.description: The plural is generic, as in a definition; recruiting one worker suffices.

citations.cite: CP arts. 206 and 207 — the plural read as generic

taken.rationale: The words, and the Code states a larger number where it wants one (art. 200). Strict construction of the type.

witnesses: `o recrutamento enganoso de uma só` — not art. 206 under the taken reading, art. 206 under `umBasta`

site.anchor: recrutamento de trabalhadores do art. 207, § 1º

source.quote: Incorre na mesma pena quem recrutar trabalhadores fora da localidade de execução do trabalho, dentro do território nacional, mediante fraude ou cobrança de qualquer quantia do trabalhador, ou, ainda, não assegurar condições do seu retorno ao local de origem.

citations.cite: CP art. 207, § 1º

readings.description: "não assegurar condições do seu retorno" is a third mode of the recruitment: the one who recruited workers away from the place of work and does not assure their return.

citations.cite: CP art. 207, § 1º — one "quem", and "seu retorno" is the recruited workers'

readings.description: It is a conduct of its own: anyone (the employer who received the workers, for instance) who does not assure their return commits § 1º.

citations.cite: CP art. 207, § 1º — "ou, ainda," read as opening a second conduct

taken.rationale: "seu retorno ao local de origem" presupposes workers brought from elsewhere by a recruitment, and the sentence has one subject.

notes: The case record describes the recruiter's conduct, so the encoding cannot exhibit the other reading, which would reach a person who recruited no one.

delegated_field: `Fato de frustração de lei sobre a nacionalização do trabalho`'s `frustração de obrigação legal relativa à nacionalização do trabalho`

site.anchor: frustração de lei sobre a nacionalização do trabalho do art. 204

source.quote: Frustrar, mediante fraude ou violência, obrigação legal relativa à nacionalização do trabalho:

citations.cite: CP art. 204

readings.description: Which legal obligations relate to the nationalisation of labour is for the law imposing them (the labour legislation's rules on the nationalisation of labour) to say; the encoding takes the finding.

citations.cite: CP art. 204 — "obrigação legal"

readings.description: Encode the obligations so that the finding is computed.
readings.rejection_rationale: Outside the source bundle and the brief.

taken.rationale: The Code points outside itself for the obligation.

notes: Whether the labour legislation's nationalisation rules survive the 1988 Constitution's equality between Brazilians and resident foreigners is a question for a lawyer; if they do not, there is no obligation to frustrate, and the finding is FALSE.

site.anchor: exercício de atividade com infração de decisão administrativa do art. 205

source.quote: Exercer atividade, de que está impedido por decisão administrativa:

citations.cite: CP art. 205

readings.description: "Exercer atividade" is the continued practice of an activity: one act is not exercising it, and the crime is habitual, with no attempt.

citations.cite: CP art. 282 — "Exercer, ainda que a título gratuito, a profissão de médico ...", the Code's other "exercer" of an occupation

readings.description: A single act of the activity is exercising it.

citations.cite: CP art. 205 — the verb read literally

taken.rationale: An activity is exercised by practising it; a single act is an act, not an activity. No authority was read; the reading is the encoder's.

witnesses: `o médico suspenso que atende uma vez` — not art. 205 under the taken reading, art. 205 under the other

site.anchor: destruição, subtração ou ocultação de cadáver do art. 211

source.quote: Destruir, subtrair ou ocultar cadáver ou parte dele:

citations.cite: CP art. 211
CP art. 212 — "Vilipendiar cadáver ou suas cinzas:"

readings.description: Each article reaches only the objects it names: art. 211 the corpse or a part of it, not the ashes; art. 212 the corpse or its ashes, not a part.

citations.cite: CP arts. 211 and 212 — adjacent articles of one Capítulo, each naming a different extension of "cadáver"
CP art. 1º — no crime without a prior law defining it

readings.description: A corpse's parts and ashes are the corpse; "parte dele" and "suas cinzas" are each for the avoidance of doubt, and both articles reach all three.

citations.cite: CP arts. 211 and 212, read by their purpose, the respect owed to the dead

taken.rationale: The two articles were drafted together and name different objects; reading each as naming everything makes one of the two phrases idle, and the extension would be against the accused.

witnesses: `as cinzas ocultadas` — not art. 211 under the taken reading
`a parte do cadáver vilipendiada` — not art. 212 under the taken reading

site.anchor: a vigência da redação atual dos arts. 184 e 186

source.quote: (Redação dada pela Lei nº 10.695, de 1º.7.2003)

citations.cite: Lei nº 10.695/2003, art. 5º: "Esta Lei entra em vigor 30 (trinta) dias após a sua publicação."; published DOU 2.7.2003 (Planalto's footer; Senado metadata datapub 02/07/2003)

readings.description: Counted as LC nº 95/1998, art. 8º, § 1º counts a vacatio: the day of publication and the last day both included, in force the day after. 2.7.2003 is day 1, 31.7.2003 day 30, so in force on 1.8.2003.

citations.cite: LC nº 95/1998, art. 8º, § 1o (incluído pela LC nº 107/2001): "A contagem do prazo para entrada em vigor das leis que estabeleçam período de vacância far-se-á com a inclusão da data da publicação e do último dia do prazo, entrando em vigor no dia subseqüente à sua consumação integral." (read on Planalto, 2026-09-29)

readings.description: Thirty days counted from the day after publication (3.7.2003 to 1.8.2003), in force on 2.8.2003.
readings.rejection_rationale: LC nº 95/1998, art. 8º, § 1º, in force since 2001, includes the day of publication in the count.

taken.rationale: The statutory rule for counting a vacatio, in force since 2001 and so before Lei nº 10.695/2003 was published. LC nº 95/1998 is outside the source bundle; its art. 8º, § 1o was read on Planalto.

witnesses: `a violação simples no dia da vigência` (1.8.2003) — decided; `a violação simples na véspera da vigência` (31.7.2003) — refuses
notes: The other two amending laws in g3b's range took effect on publication: Lei nº 9.777/1998 (arts. 203 and 207; DOU 30.12.1998) and Lei nº 8.683/1993 (art. 206; DOU 16.7.1993), each read on Planalto on 2026-09-29.

source.quote: Escarnecer de alguém publicamente, por motivo de crença ou função religiosa;

citations.cite: CP art. 208

readings.description: "alguém" is a particular person, mocked because of their own belief or religious office.

citations.cite: CP art. 208 — "de alguém", as in "Constranger alguém" (arts. 146, 197)

readings.description: Mocking a religion, or its faithful in general, is enough.
readings.rejection_rationale: The text says "alguém"; the same article's third figure reaches what is directed at the worship itself (its acts and objects), so the first need not stretch to cover it.

site.anchor: aliciamento de trabalhadores do art. 207, caput

source.quote: Aliciar trabalhadores, com o fim de levá-los de uma para outra localidade do território nacional:

citations.cite: CP art. 207, caput
CP art. 207, § 1º — "quem recrutar trabalhadores"
CP art. 206 — "Recrutar trabalhadores"

readings.description: "aliciar" (to entice) and "recrutar" (to recruit) are different conducts. Recruiting to move workers within the country is § 1º's, and only with its conditions (away from the place of work, and fraud, charging, or no assured return).

citations.cite: CP art. 207, § 1º, added in 1998 with the caput's own penalty

readings.description: "aliciar" includes any recruiting, so any recruiting to move workers within the country is the caput's.

citations.cite: CP art. 207, caput — "Aliciar", undefined

taken.rationale: If "aliciar" included recruiting, § 1º — which punishes recruiting only under stated conditions, with the same penalty — would add nothing. A provision is not read as idle when a reading gives it work.

witnesses: `o recrutamento sem aliciamento para outro estado` — not art. 207 under the taken reading, the caput under the other

site.anchor: Fato de constrangimento contra a organização do trabalho

source.quote: Constranger alguém, mediante violência ou grave ameaça

readings.description: The crime is consummated when the victim does, or refrains from, what the agent constrained them to; violence or a threat that did not bend the victim is an attempt.

citations.cite: CP arts. 197–199 — "Constranger alguém ... a": the constraint is to a result

readings.description: The crime is consummated when the violence or serious threat is used to that end, whether or not the victim gives in.

citations.cite: CP arts. 197–199 — "Constranger ... mediante violência ou grave ameaça", read as the use of the means

taken.rationale: "Constranger alguém a" names the result the constraint aims at; until the victim gives in, the agent has tried to constrain. The case record's herald for the stage of execution says so, so the fact supplier records a victim who resisted as `execução interrompida por circunstâncias alheias à vontade do agente`.

witnesses: `a não exercer o ofício, tentado` — an attempt (reduced by one to two thirds) under the taken reading, consummated under the other

delegated_field: `Ato contra o respeito aos mortos`'s conduta, recorded as `ato lícito`

site.anchor: Conduta contra o respeito aos mortos

source.quote: Violar ou profanar sepultura ou urna funerária:

citations.cite: CP art. 210
CP art. 211 — "Destruir, subtrair ou ocultar cadáver ou parte dele:"
CP art. 212 — "Vilipendiar cadáver ou suas cinzas:"

readings.description: An act done with authority or with respect (an authorised restoration of a tomb, an authorised exhumation or cremation, ashes scattered respectfully) is not "violar", "profanar", "destruir" or "vilipendiar" at all: the fact supplier records it as `ato lícito` and arts. 210 to 212 are not made out.

citations.cite: CP arts. 210 to 212 — the verbs (violar, profanar, vilipendiar) describe disrespect; an authorised act shows none

readings.description: The act is still "violar" or "destruir"; the authorisation only excludes unlawfulness (exercício regular de direito or estrito cumprimento de dever legal, art. 23, III), so the elements are made out and the justification is a separate question.

citations.cite: CP art. 23, III — the exclusion of unlawfulness for the regular exercise of a right

taken.rationale: The record has to be able to state a lawful act; the smallest shape is one more conduct, `ato lícito`, which none of arts. 210 to 212 asks for. Whoever supplies the facts decides whether an authorised act counts as the verb; the encoding does not guess. Under the other reading the supplier records the verb and art. 23 (g1a's) carries the justification.

witnesses: `a sepultura restaurada com autorização` — no crime under the taken reading
`as cinzas espalhadas com respeito` — no crime under the taken reading

delegated_field: the agent's knowledge that the original or copy was reproduced in violation of copyright: `o agente sabia que o original ou cópia fora reproduzido com violação de direito` (art. 184 § 2º, first limb)

site.anchor: o agente conhecia a violação na origem da cópia

citations.cite: CP art. 18, parágrafo único
CP art. 20

source.quote: Parágrafo único - Salvo os casos expressos em lei, ninguém pode ser punido por fato previsto como crime, senão quando o pratica dolosamente.

readings.description: That the copy was pirated is an element of the first limb of § 2º (distribui, vende, expõe à venda, aluga, introduz, adquire, oculta, tem em depósito 'reproduzido com violação'), so knowing it is part of the dolo (art. 18 p.ú.), and art. 184 has no culpable form. Not knowing is an error about an element (art. 20). A positive finding on the case; absent, the first limb is not made out. An agent who reproduced the copy himself (the conduct of § 1º) knows it and needs no separate finding.

citations.cite: CP art. 18, parágrafo único
CP art. 20

readings.description: Knowledge is presumed from the profit purpose and the dealing; ignorance is a defence the case must assert.
readings.rejection_rationale: Dolo is an element of the crime, not an exception to it (art. 18 p.ú.); the module before this fork convicted a reseller who believed the copy licensed (s-dolo-audit, 2026-10).

readings.description: Carry cp-dominio's `Elemento subjetivo` (dolo, culpa) on the case.
readings.rejection_rationale: Art. 184 has no culpable form, so `culpa` could only mean 'no crime', and the case at issue (a dealer who believed the copy licensed) is an error about an element that dolo/culpa cannot state.

taken.rationale: A finding of fact, positive, named after what the paragraph says the copy is. Read by the first limb of § 2º only.

witnesses: cp-g3b-propriedade-imaterial-testes.l4: `o revendedor que julgava a cópia licenciada`, `a exposição à venda, sem saber da pirataria`, `o depósito, sem saber da pirataria`, `a importação, sem saber da pirataria` → no crime; `a venda de CD pirata` → § 2º; `quem reproduz e vende, sem achado separado de saber` → § 2º
notes: Checked and left without a separate finding: art. 184 caput and § 1º (the agent's own violation and reproduction; the caput is the violation itself, § 1º is reproduction by the agent); § 3º (the agent's own offering to the public on demand); § 2º's rental limb ('aluga … sem a expressa autorização'): the missing authorisation is the existing `autorização expressa` fact supplied by the fact supplier, and a renter who believed himself licensed may be an error about an element (art. 20) that the supplier records as authorisation present; a second finding is open to the lead if that is not enough; art. 186 (the same conduct as 184, with an ação penal, no new verb).
Not knowing that the law forbids such dealing (art. 21) is not encoded as excluding dolo.
